questions.question_text: You need to create a new Microsoft Entra user for an employee. Which blade should you select in the Microsoft Entra ID portal?

options.label: A
options.text: Users > All users > Add

options.label: B
options.text: Groups > New group

options.label: C
options.text: Devices > Add device

options.label: D
options.text: Applications > New application

questions.explanation: In the Microsoft Entra ID portal, you create a user by selecting Users, then All users, and then Add. See Microsoft Entra ID documentation: Create a user.

questions.question_text: An administrator wants to add a custom attribute 'Department' to a user in Microsoft Entra ID. Which method should they use?

options.label: A
options.text: Edit the user in the Azure AD portal and type the attribute directly

options.label: B
options.text: Use Azure AD Graph API to update the user's extension attribute

options.label: C
options.text: Create a new group with the department name

options.label: D
options.text: Assign the user to a role that includes the attribute

questions.explanation: Custom attributes are set via the Azure AD Graph API (or Microsoft Graph) using extensions. See Microsoft Entra ID documentation on user attributes.

questions.question_text: A user is assigned a Microsoft 365 E3 license, but the license is not available because the tenant has reached its maximum license count. Which action should the administrator take to resolve this?

options.label: A
options.text: Remove an existing user to free a license

options.label: B
options.text: Purchase additional licenses from the admin center

options.label: C
options.text: Change the user's license type to a different SKU without affecting availability

options.label: D
options.text: Use the License management blade to increase the tenant's license limit

questions.explanation: When the tenant license count is reached, you need to purchase additional licenses via the Microsoft 365 admin center. See Microsoft Entra ID licensing documentation.

questions.question_text: To invite a partner organization’s user as a guest to Microsoft Entra ID, which option should you select in the 'New user' blade?

options.label: A
options.text: Select 'User' and set account type to 'Member'

options.label: B
options.text: Select 'Guest' and provide the email address

options.label: C
options.text: Select 'B2B collaboration' and enter the user's tenant ID

options.label: D
options.text: Select 'External Identity' and upload a CSV file

questions.explanation: In the New user blade, you choose 'Guest user' to invite external users. Refer to Microsoft Entra ID B2B collaboration documentation.

questions.question_text: An organization wants to enable self-service password reset for its users while restricting it to members of a specific Azure AD group. Which configuration step is required?

options.label: A
options.text: Enable SSPR in the Microsoft Entra ID portal and then assign the 'Password Reset' role to the group

options.label: B
options.text: Turn on 'Authentication methods' in Azure AD and then manually reset passwords for group members

options.label: C
options.text: Configure Conditional Access to block SSPR for non‑group members

options.label: D
options.text: Create a new authentication method specifically for the group

questions.explanation: Enable SSPR in the Microsoft Entra ID portal, then assign the 'Password Reset' role to the desired security group. See Microsoft Entra ID SSPR documentation.

questions.question_text: A company uses a dynamic group in Microsoft Entra ID that includes users whose job title contains 'Developer'. After a user changes their job title to 'Senior Developer', the user remains in the group. Which statement best describes why this occurs?

options.label: A
options.text: Dynamic groups evaluate membership only when the user is added

options.label: B
options.text: The group's rule uses the 'contains' operator which matches 'Senior Developer'

options.label: C
options.text: The user's object ID was manually added to the group

options.label: D
options.text: The group is set to 'User-based' instead of dynamic

questions.explanation: Dynamic groups are evaluated based on the rule expression; the 'contains' operator matches any title that includes the specified string, so 'Senior Developer' still satisfies the rule. Refer to Microsoft Entra ID documentation on dynamic group rules.

questions.question_text: Which PowerShell cmdlet can be used to view all properties of a specific Microsoft Entra user?

options.label: A
options.text: Get-MgUser -UserId <user> -Property *

options.label: B
options.text: Get-AzureADUser -ObjectId <user>

options.label: C
options.text: Get-MgUser -UserId <user>

options.label: D
options.text: Get-EntraUser -TenantId <tenant>

questions.explanation: The Get-MgUser cmdlet with the -Property * parameter retrieves all user properties. See Microsoft Entra ID PowerShell guide.

questions.question_text: A guest user from a partner company has been assigned a Microsoft 365 license, but the license is not active. What is the most likely cause?

options.label: A
options.text: Guest users are not directly assigned licenses; they are assigned through their home tenant

options.label: B
options.text: The license was assigned before the guest accepted the invitation

options.label: C
options.text: Licenses are not available for guest accounts

options.label: D
options.text: The tenant's license count was exceeded for guest accounts

questions.explanation: Guest users are typically managed in their home tenant; licenses are assigned via the home tenant or through the Azure AD B2B collaboration settings. See Microsoft Entra ID external identities documentation.

questions.question_text: An administrator wants to enable self-service password reset for all users but exclude users in a specific Azure AD group. Which combination of settings achieves this?

options.label: A
options.text: Enable SSPR for all users, then disable the 'Password Reset' role for the excluded group

options.label: B
options.text: Create a separate SSPR policy for the excluded group and assign it to all users except that group

options.label: C
options.text: Turn on SSPR at the tenant level, then use Conditional Access to block SSPR for the excluded group

options.label: D
options.text: Use the 'Authentication methods' blade to remove the excluded group from the SSPR registration

questions.explanation: Enable SSPR tenant-wide, then configure a Conditional Access policy that denies SSPR access for the specific group. Refer to Microsoft Entra ID Conditional Access documentation.

questions.question_text: To create a new Microsoft Entra group for project team members, which blade should you select?

options.label: A
options.text: Users > Groups > New group

options.label: B
options.text: Devices > Groups > New group

options.label: C
options.text: Applications > Groups > New group

options.label: D
options.text: Roles > Groups > New group

questions.explanation: In the Microsoft Entra ID portal, you create a group by selecting Users, then Groups, then New group. See Microsoft Entra ID documentation on creating groups.
